meta_description:
9,822 likes, 42 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 16, 2026: "Eating with locals is fun
But cooking with them is next level!

While exploring Sikkim, I got to learn how to make a local buckwheat pancake/ chilla with someone who’s perfected local looking with foraged veggies and homegrown ingredients. And honestly, the cooking, the smell, the flavours and little laughs along the way were just as memorable as the food itself.

Sometimes you can experience the place better when you seek an offbeat adventure and cook with the local ingredients instead of just tasting the food served to you.

Check out more from my time in Sikkim in my latest YouTube video.".
